title: A novel 3D energetic MOF of high energy content: synthesis and superior explosive performance of a Pb(                     <scp>ii</scp>                     ) compound with 5,5′-bistetrazole-1,1′-diolate
abstract: A novel 3D energetic metal–organic framework (MOF) of exceptionally high energy content, [Pb(BTO)(H                     2                     O)]                     n                     , was synthesized and structurally characterized by single crystal X-ray diffraction.
